title: 「More importantly：帶出更重要的一點」
titleEn: Using more importantly to introduce a higher-priority point

source.file: Sentence Structure 139 -「More importantly：帶出更重要的一點」.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Less important point. More importantly, + more important point

formulas.formula: Less important point. More importantly, + more important point

example: The policy is affordable. More importantly, it is fair.
exampleZh: 這項政策是負擔得起的。更重要的是，它是公平的。

examples.en: The policy is affordable. More importantly, it is fair.
examples.zh: 這項政策是負擔得起的。更重要的是，它是公平的。

rules.zh: More importantly 用來先承認第一點，再帶出一個更值得重視的第二點。
rules.en: Use more importantly to acknowledge a first point before introducing a second point that deserves greater attention.

rules.zh: 在本練習中，第一點後使用句號；More importantly 放在新一句的開頭，後面加逗號。
rules.en: In this exercise, end the first point with a full stop, begin a new sentence with More importantly, and place a comma after the phrase.

rules.zh: More importantly 後面必須接完整句子，不可只接一個名詞或形容詞。 4. 第二點必須真的比第一點重要；如果兩點同等重要，便不應使用這個句型。
rules.en: More importantly must introduce a complete sentence, not merely a noun or adjective. The second point must genuinely be more important than the first; do not use the phrase if both points have equal importance.

rules.zh: 不要混淆 more importantly 和 more important： More important 是形容詞比較級；More importantly 則用來連接並排列兩個觀點。
rules.en: Do not confuse the sentence adverb more importantly with the adjective phrase more important. More important is a comparative adjective, whereas More importantly links and ranks two points.
examples: Safety is more important than speed.
The plan is fast. More importantly, it is safe.

rules.zh: More importantly 表示後一點比前一點重要；Most importantly 則通常用來帶出多個要 點之中最重要的一點。
rules.en: More importantly says that the later point is more important than the earlier one; most importantly normally introduces the single most important point among several.

benefits.zh: 清楚顯示重點 這個句型能直接告訴讀者或聽者：第二點比第一點更值得留意。
benefits.en: It clearly signals the main priority by telling readers or listeners directly that the second point deserves more attention than the first.

benefits.zh: 令論點更有層次 你可以先提出一個普通好處，再逐步帶出較有力的理由，使作文、報告和口語答案更有組織。
benefits.en: It gives an argument a clearer hierarchy. You can begin with an ordinary benefit and then build towards a stronger reason, making an essay, report or spoken answer better organized.

benefits.zh: 幫助讀者跟上你的思路 More importantly 像一個路標，提醒讀者接下來才是你真正想強調的內容。
benefits.en: It helps readers follow your reasoning by acting as a signpost that the point you most want to emphasize is coming next.

benefits.zh: 把兩個完整觀點自然連接起來 它能避免只用 and 或 but 串連所有句子，令表達不那麼重複。
benefits.en: It connects two complete points naturally and avoids linking every sentence with only and or but.

benefits.zh: 用較短方式表達優先次序 你不需要每次都寫 the more important point is that，也能簡潔地帶出較重要的一點。
benefits.en: It expresses priority concisely, introducing the more important point without repeatedly writing the more important point is that.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.
